fields.description: Issue includes editorials and political commentary on Miami city commission elections and slates, criticism of Florida Power & Light Company and public-utility contracts (including bus and water-rate issues), and discussion of Everglades drainage proposals. Coverage also notes efforts to attract the Democratic National Convention to Miami, local civic promotion and boosterism, and a campaign to fund a University of Miami football stadium. Includes recurring humor/columns (e.g., “Little Geraldine,” “What a Miami Bride Should Know”), letters to the editor, and advertisements for local businesses and services.
